newsitem.title: USA: Universal Hospital sets special committee.
newsitem.headline: Universal Hospital sets special committee.

text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc said Thursday its board established a special committee of outside directors to consider strategic alternatives.

Earlier this month, the company said it received a letter from an unidentified suitor interested in negotiating a purchase. Universal Hospital said Piper Jaffray Inc, its advisor, has also been soliciting interest from unidentified parties and will report to the committee this month.
The efforts of the independent directors will free Universal Hospital management to continue to focus on running the company's daily operations, the company said.
Universal Hospital provides mobile medical equipment to hospitals.
